sample_a.population_definition: Tier-1 distinct triples (doc_index, norm(subject), relation, norm(object)) over routed tier==1 rows with NO exact gold match under the frozen instrument (redocred_scoring.match_arm, raw arm). The control stratum is drawn from the exact-matched distinct triples.
sample_a.allocation_rule: proportional (largest remainder) with a floor of 60 in the smaller stratum (design 3.1)
sample_a.blinding: judge records carry no gold status, stratum or control flag; controls are mixed into the queue unlabeled (queue order = seeded shuffle) and are reported beside the estimate, never inside it (design 3.1)

sample_b.purpose: Direction B — pair-supported fraction g_B for ceiling-adjusted recall (design 3.1/3.3)
sample_b.population_definition: ALL dev gold triples (the design's registered frame: g_B is a property of gold overall). Each item's run fate is recorded in the key file only, so loss-stratum readouts remain computable at aggregation.
sample_b.allocation_rule: proportional floors (44/27/328) with the remaining seat to the largest stratum (rest410) = the design's stated 44/27/329
sample_b.blinding: judge records carry no run fate or reachability; both live only in the key file

corrected_precision.p_A_hat: stratified supported-as-typed fraction over Direction A: sum_h (N_h / N_pool) * p_h over decisive judged items per stratum h (unknown / unverifiable-quote verdicts excluded from denominators, design 3.2); control items NEVER enter the estimator
corrected_precision.interval: stratified standard error on p_A_hat (Wilson-style 95%), propagated through the formula (design 3.3); census constants from s3_raw_scores.json FULL-500 (and CONF-440 when its subset n >= 150)

ceiling_adjusted_recall.g_B_hat: stratified pair-supported fraction over Direction B: sum_h (N_h / N) * p_h with h = document population; decisive items only; the type-incorrect rate among pair-supported items is reported beside it and changes no denominator (design 3.3)
ceiling_adjusted_recall.interval: Wilson interval on g_B_hat inverted through the denominator (design 3.3)

estimators.final_verdict_rule: pass-2 verdict stands where an item was escalated, else pass-1 (design 3.2); unresolved items are counted as unlabeled and excluded from denominators
